{{Top}}
[[File:Path_of_Evil_SWG_TCG_by_Pedro.jpg|thumb|250px|A darksider walking along a lava river]]
'''Magma''' was the liquid state of [[rock]] when melted by some means, from the internal heating of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] or by a hot body such as a [[Star/Legends|star]]. Upon reaching the surface of a planet, via such processes as [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]], magma became known as '''lava'''.

It was occasionally [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on such planets as [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. On [[Qat Chrystac/Legends|Qat Chrystac]], the magma was highly [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]].
